meta.description: SecuX ML training dataset v2 — labeled log entries from OTRF Security-Datasets, LogHub OpenSSH, and UNSW-NB15. Each entry contains a raw log line/record, source filename for parser routing, and expected detection types. Use expected_types: [] for benign.
sources: UNSW-NB15: UNSW-NB15_1.csv through UNSW-NB15_4.csv (2,540,047 total records; 48 sampled)
meta.notes: Genuine log-based entries only. UNSW-NB15 network flow entries removed — those had attack_cat labels embedded in raw JSON (circular), not genuine detection.
